Eph 1:3-6
3 Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,
who has blessed us with every spiritual blessing
in the heavenly places,
4 just as He chose us in Him before the foundation of the world,
that we should be holy and without blame before Him in love,
5 having predestined us to adoption as sons
by Jesus Christ to Himself,
according to the good pleasure of His will,
6 to the praise of the glory of His grace,
by which He made us accepted in the Beloved.

Rev 2:7 ...
To him who overcomes I will give to eat from the tree of life,

Heb 1:13-14
14 Are they not all ministering spirits sent forth to minister for those who will inherit salvation?

14 Are angels not all ministering spirits
sent forth to minister
for those who will inherit salvation?

2 Do you not know that the saints will judge the world?
And if the world will be judged by you,
are you unworthy to judge the smallest matters?

3 Do you not know that we shall judge angels?
How much more, things that pertain to this life?

Rom 8:19-21
19 For the earnest expectation of the creation
eagerly waits for the revealing of the sons of God.
20 For the creation was subjected to futility, not willingly,
but because of Him who subjected it in hope;
21 because the creation itself also
will be delivered from the bondage of corruption
into the glorious liberty of the children of God.

17 For God did not send His Son into the world to condemn the world,

Psa 82:1-2
1 A Psalm of Asaph.
God stands in the congregation of the mighty; (heavenly beings)
He judges among the gods (elohim - gods).
2 How long will you judge unjustly,
And show partiality to the wicked?

14 For this reason
I bow my knees to the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,
15 from whom the whole family in heaven and earth is named.

6 By the Word of Yahweh, the heavens were made,
And all the host of them by the breath of His mouth.

This book of Jubilees is not inspired scripture but shows what people of that time might of believed.

1 And the angel of the presence spake to Moses according to the word of the Lord, saying:

2 Write the complete history of the creation, how in six days the Lord God finished all His works and all that He created, and kept Sabbath on the seventh day and hallowed it for all ages, and appointed it as a sign for all His works.

3 For on the first day He created the heavens which are above and the earth and the waters and all the spirits which serve before Him

4 --the angels of the presence, and the angels of sanctification, and the angels of the spirit of fire and the angels of the spirit of the winds, and the angels of the spirit of the clouds,

5 and of darkness, and of snow and of hail and of hoar frost, and the angels of the voices and of the thunder and of the lightning, and the angels of the spirits of cold and of heat, and of winter and of spring and of autumn and of summer,

6 and of all the spirits of His creatures which are in the heavens and on the earth.
(He created) the abysses and the darkness, eventide (and night), and the light, dawn and day, which He hath prepared in the knowledge of His heart.

6 By the Word of Yahweh, the heavens were made,
And all the host of them by the breath (ruach: Spirit) of His mouth.

7 He gathers the waters of the sea together as a heap;
He lays up the deep in storehouses.

8 Let all the earth fear Yahweh;
Let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of Him.

9 For He spoke, and it was done;
He commanded, and it stood fast.

This book of Jubilees is not inspired scripture but shows what people of that time might of believed.

God stands in the congregation of the mighty; (heavenly beings)
He judges among the gods (elohim - gods).
...

6 I said, “You are gods,

And all of you are children of the Most High. (Yahweh)

4 Yahweh counts the number of the stars;
He calls them all by name.

5 Great is our Lord,
and mighty in power;
His understanding is infinite.

31 Then God saw everything that He had made,

and indeed it was very good.

1 The heavens declare the glory of God;
And the firmament shows His handiwork.

1 The heavens declare the glory of God;
And the firmament shows His handiwork.

2 Day unto day utters speech,
And night unto night reveals knowledge.

3 There is no speech nor language
where their voice is not heard.

4 Their line has gone out through all the earth,
And their words to the end of the world.
In them He has set a tabernacle for the sun.

20 For since the creation of the world,
God's invisible attributes are clearly seen,
being understood by the things that are made,
even His eternal power and Godhead,
so that they are without excuse.

21 because,
although they knew God,
they did not glorify Him as God,
nor were thankful,
but became futile in their thoughts,
and their foolish hearts were darkened.

7 Then I will give them a heart to know Me,
that I am Yahweh;
and they shall be My people,
and I will be their God,
for they shall return to Me with their whole heart.

29 And God said, “See, I have given you every herb that yields seed which is on the face of all the earth, and every tree whose fruit yields seed; to you it shall be for food.

30 Also, to every beast of the earth, to every bird of the air, and to everything that creeps on the earth, in which there is life, I have given every green herb for food”; and it was so.

31 Then God saw everything that He had made, and indeed it was very good.

9 And out of the ground Yahweh God made every tree grow
that is pleasant to the sight and good for food.
The tree of life was also in the midst of the garden,
and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.

Eph 1:3-5
3 Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,
who has blessed us with
every spiritual blessing in the heavenly places,
4 just as He chose us in Him before the foundation of the world,
that we should be holy and without blame before Him in love,
5 having predestined us to adoption as sons
by Jesus Christ to Himself,
according to the good pleasure of His will,

6 ...Those who trouble you ...

8 ... and who do not obey the gospel of our Lord Jesus Christ.

9 shall be punished with everlasting destruction

10 Have we not all one Father?
Has not one God created us?

6 One God and Father of all,
who is above all,
and through all,
and in you all.

22 Then Yahweh God said,
"Behold, the man has become like one of Us,
to know good and evil.
And now,
lest he put out his hand and take also of the tree of life,
and eat, and live forever"—

23 therefore
Yahweh God sent him out of the garden of Eden
to till the ground from which he was taken.

24 So He drove out the man;
and He placed cherubim at the east of the garden of Eden,
and a flaming sword which turned every way,
to guard the way to the tree of life.
